game_title: Doubling Growth – Moss Door Chamber Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber, a mossy sealed door: the shadow ranger must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Doubling Growth: Double a size each pass with while size < goal to grow the supply cache fast.
theme: Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber: a mossy sealed door
core_gameplay_loop: In Moss Door Chamber, repeat each round: Double a size each pass with while size < goal to grow the supply cache fast. Each round, a new pickaxes challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the size value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 460 points of pickaxes by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 460, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Doubling Growth
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Doubling Growth' (Week 4 slot 12), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Moss Door Chamber'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how size changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against skeleton miners in Moss Door Chamber.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 460 within 57 seconds.
